decisions.label: clear
decisions.evidence: We may collect and use non-personally identifiable information and data from you when you are visiting the Site through the standard operation of our Internet servers. Non-personally identifiable information collected from you may include user Internet Protocol (IP) addresses, browser types, domain names, and anonymous statistical data regarding your use of the Site.
decisions.rationale: The policy discloses the collection of non-personally identifiable information but does not specify the recipient or purpose, and retains data indefinitely.

raw.disclosing_quote: We may collect and use non-personally identifiable information and data from you when you are visiting the Site through the standard operation of our Internet servers. raw.generic_quote: We may collect and use non-personally identifiable information and data from you when you are visiting the Site through the standard operation of our Internet servers. Non-personally identifiable information collected from you may include user Internet Protocol (IP) addresses, browser types, domain names, and anonymous statistical data regarding your use of the Site.
raw.purpose_quote: We collect personally identifiable information about you when you specifically and knowingly provide such information voluntarily on the Site, including, but not limited to, during the following interactions: (1) when you register on the Site and when you later log-on with your user name and password; (2) when you sign-up to subscribe to a service, a newsletter, or ask to be added to our mailing lists for other products or services; (3) when you place an order for products or services; (4) when you participate in a promotional offer; (5) when you provide feedback in an online survey; (6) when you submit other content and suggestions.
raw.unspecified_purpose_quote: We may from time to time use your personally identifiable information to notify you of special offers and products and services from The Hill and/or from third parties that we think may be of interest to you.
raw.retention_quote: We take every effort to protect against unauthorized access to your personal information, and have put in place commercially reasonable physical, electronic, and managerial procedures to safeguard and secure the information we collect on the Site.
raw.rationale: The policy discloses the collection of non-personally identifiable information but does not specify the recipient or purpose, and retains data indefinitely.
